changelog: Updated [When to Segment]: added an explicit guidance to avoid placing candidates inside quoted/delimited spans and to keep quoted named phrases atomic so tags do not split titles or names.

Strengthened [Never Segment]: explicitly forbid inserting boundaries inside any matched parenthesis/bracket pair, inside any quoted/delimited span before its closing delimiter, and inside contiguous runs of Latin-script letters/digits (including multiword Latin names) — this prevents tags from breaking atomic tokens or names.

Adjusted [Decision Procedure]: added a deterministic pre-check (applied before candidate marking) that excludes positions forbidden by [Never Segment] (inside matched parentheses/brackets, inside open quoted spans, or inside contiguous Latin runs), ensuring marked candidates never split atomic spans.
